english.note: Use this colloquial expression when talking about working out to look bigger and stronger, rather than using fitness terminology.

examples.english: After work, Keung always goes to the gym, saying he needs to bulk up before he can win a girl's heart.
examples.traditional: 阿強成日放工去健身室，話要練大隻先追到女仔。
